title: Dishonest booking practices of the Shaw Agency and Joe Glaser
summary: He caught the Shaw agency in split commissions and notes how Glaser protected Hampton's interests.

story.theme_name: Getting paid: wages, tips and leaving over money
story.community_name: Managers, bookers and the business of getting work

blocks.x: Oh, sure, you run into that. Now I'll tell you, there was a Shaw Booking Agency, now they had their way of showing you, but I called their hand several times and I found out that was going on, where they get it. In other words what I'm talking about, Walt Foots--Foots left Cab Calloway, he

Shaw was booking on several things and they'd send me what it was and then after when I played the engagement, here would come a guy up, I'm supposed to get a hundred dollars, and he would show it in black and white where the agency promised him. They wouldn't get it in front, you know, but this guy was responsible for getting the engagement, but they had a split commission or something, (inaudible). After I called the hand I found out (inaudible). When you're around you need help every kind of way, and I think I learned--you know, live and learn. That's why (inaudible) did so well, is because Joe Glaser has a piece of it.
Plus he had a protector, Gladys. Gladys protected the Hamp's interest and her own too, because his interests were hers.
